items.name: boot-log
items.title: BootLog
items.description: Boot-sequence log: lines typed one after another with timestamps and status tags, in a role=log live region (polite). Runs longer than 5 s get pause/resume and skip controls. Reduced or off motion prints every line at once.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The boot sequence is illustrative text generated from the props; no original assets are used.
